seed_aggregation: Mean of five paired log-score differences, not a logmeanexp mixture-density ensemble
primary_uncertainty: Paired exact bootstrap within 42 launched strata; physical S0 contributes zero numerator and zero eligibility denominator; preserve fixed launched design and allow eligible counts/mixture to vary; 2000 replicates. Fixed trained-model uncertainty, separate from optimizer-seed spread.
secondary_groups: 42 predefined physical groups on fresh data: predeclared follow-up of the earlier post-hoc A/B description. Group count is not independent replication or a regional-failure theorem.
mechanism: Exact base/Jacobian/shared-scale/support arithmetic plus operational residual and PIT diagnostics; no unique physical location/scale/shape causal decomposition. Source-only56-bin common refinement for coarse-condition location diagnostic.
fresh_gate: Complete declared model roster and protocols/analysis/code/source hashes frozen before official C/D generation; no fresh-result selection or retuning
preservation: All earlier protocols/models/results remain unchanged; new namespace and outputs; raw fresh data and full caches excluded from public mirror
